disclaimer_zh: 角色、主体、资源和时序均为概念建议；不代表现有机构、预算、采购、许可或实施承诺。
disclaimer_en: Roles, entities, resources and timing are conceptual proposals; they imply no existing institutional, budget, procurement, permit or implementation commitment.

action_packages.name_en: Public ground truth and rights baseline
action_packages.accountable_role_zh: 资料协调角色 + 持证专业团队
action_packages.accountable_role_en: Data coordination role + licensed professional team
action_packages.acceptance_evidence_zh: 来源、许可、临时/正式状态和缺口台账
action_packages.acceptance_evidence_en: Source, licence, provisional/official status and gap register
action_packages.hard_stop_zh: 关键边界冲突未解则只做研究，不落位
action_packages.hard_stop_en: Unresolved boundary conflict limits work to research

action_packages.accountable_role_zh: 公共空间与无障碍共测组
action_packages.acceptance_evidence_zh: 步行、休息、求助、过街与夜间任务基线
action_packages.acceptance_evidence_en: Baseline for walking, rest, help, crossing and night tasks
action_packages.hard_stop_zh: 安全断点未隔离则不发布数字路线
action_packages.hard_stop_en: Do not publish digital routes while safety breaks remain

action_packages.acceptance_evidence_zh: 真人窗口、纸本、电话、固定牌与静音空间
action_packages.acceptance_evidence_en: Staffed desk, paper, phone, fixed panel and quiet commons
action_packages.hard_stop_zh: 任一核心任务断网后不可完成则 Hold
action_packages.hard_stop_en: Hold if a core task fails offline

action_packages.accountable_role_zh: 数据/安全负责人 + 公众代表
action_packages.acceptance_evidence_zh: 契约、版本、失败、申诉、删除与复审记录
action_packages.acceptance_evidence_en: Contract, version, failure, appeal, deletion and review records
action_packages.hard_stop_zh: 责任人或 Stop 条件缺失则不得试点
action_packages.hard_stop_en: No pilot without accountability or stop condition

action_packages.accountable_role_zh: 测试治理委员会建议角色
action_packages.acceptance_evidence_zh: 模型边界、具身接管、能耗和失败样本
action_packages.acceptance_evidence_en: Model limits, embodied takeover, energy and failure samples
action_packages.hard_stop_zh: 越权、伤害或接管失败立即 Stop
action_packages.hard_stop_en: Unauthorized access, harm or takeover failure triggers Stop

action_packages.accountable_role_zh: 领域专家 + 社区共评组
action_packages.acceptance_evidence_zh: 问题集、来源卡、撤回记录和人工转介
action_packages.acceptance_evidence_en: Problem set, provenance card, withdrawal and human referral
action_packages.hard_stop_zh: 医疗诊断、未成年人过采集或来源冲突立即 Stop
action_packages.hard_stop_en: Diagnosis, excess child data or provenance conflict triggers Stop

action_packages.accountable_role_zh: 商圈运营建议角色 + 消费者代表
action_packages.acceptance_evidence_zh: 产品护照、多语服务、法律信息和投诉闭环
action_packages.acceptance_evidence_en: Product passports, multilingual service, legal information and complaint closure
action_packages.hard_stop_zh: 夸大能力、隐瞒供应商或无法转人工则下架
action_packages.hard_stop_en: Remove service for exaggerated claims, hidden supplier or failed handoff

action_packages.acceptance_evidence_zh: 去标识问题包、复测报告和跨区差异
action_packages.acceptance_evidence_en: De-identified problem packs, retest reports and cross-area differences
action_packages.hard_stop_zh: 不得交换个人数据、商业秘密或虚构资源承诺
action_packages.hard_stop_en: No personal data, trade secrets or implied resource commitments

action_packages.accountable_role_zh: 公共价值委员会建议角色
action_packages.acceptance_evidence_zh: 删除证明、场地恢复、继任责任、少数意见与长期价值
action_packages.acceptance_evidence_en: Deletion proof, site restoration, succession, minority opinion and long-term value
action_packages.hard_stop_zh: 无法删除、恢复或维持非 AI 服务则不得扩围或碑刻
action_packages.hard_stop_en: No scale or monument if deletion, restoration or non-AI continuity fails

decision_gates.decision_zh: 问题是否值得公共介入
decision_gates.minimum_evidence_zh: 受影响人群、现状任务、非 AI 方案
decision_gates.minimum_evidence_en: Affected publics, current task and non-AI option

decision_gates.decision_zh: 权利与资料是否允许准备
decision_gates.minimum_evidence_zh: 来源许可、最小数据、空间安全、责任角色
decision_gates.minimum_evidence_en: Provenance, minimum data, spatial safety and accountable roles

decision_gates.minimum_evidence_zh: 版本锁定、真人服务、接管演练、Stop 与恢复
decision_gates.minimum_evidence_en: Version lock, staffed service, takeover drill, stop and recovery

decision_gates.minimum_evidence_zh: 对照结果、分组表现、事件、申诉和运维负担
decision_gates.minimum_evidence_en: Comparator, subgroup outcomes, incidents, appeals and maintenance burden

decision_gates.minimum_evidence_zh: 相同契约、差异说明、资源账和新责任签署
decision_gates.minimum_evidence_en: Same contract, difference note, resource account and renewed accountability

decision_gates.decision_zh: 扩大、修复、退出还是碑刻
decision_gates.minimum_evidence_zh: 跨季公共价值、删除恢复、继任和少数意见
decision_gates.minimum_evidence_en: Cross-season public value, deletion/restoration, succession and minority opinion

resource_accounts.minimum_record_zh: 真人窗口、夜班交接、专业复核、无障碍共测与维护工时
resource_accounts.minimum_record_en: Staffed service, night handover, professional review, accessibility co-test and maintenance hours

resource_accounts.minimum_record_zh: 无消费停留、测试隔离、静音界面、恢复范围与占用时段
resource_accounts.minimum_record_en: Non-purchase stay, test separation, quiet interface, restoration area and occupation time

resource_accounts.minimum_record_zh: 字段、来源、许可、访问角色、期限、删除与禁止用途
resource_accounts.minimum_record_en: Fields, provenance, licence, access roles, retention, deletion and prohibited uses

resource_accounts.minimum_record_zh: 端侧/云端能耗边界、设备热负担、低功耗退化模式
resource_accounts.minimum_record_en: Edge/cloud energy boundary, thermal burden and low-power degraded mode

resource_accounts.minimum_record_zh: 故障 SLA、备件、清洁、内容更新、供应商退出与继任
resource_accounts.minimum_record_en: Failure SLA, spares, cleaning, content update, supplier exit and succession

resource_accounts.minimum_record_zh: 停止触发、通知、数据删除、设备撤场、空间复原与档案保留
resource_accounts.minimum_record_en: Stop trigger, notice, deletion, equipment removal, site restoration and retained archive
